2608.12220.title: SCOUT: Unlocking Enhanced Spatial Reasoning via Structured Chain-of-Thought and Multi-Objective Process Reward
2608.12220.paper_summary: Existing Vision-Language Models (VLMs) exhibits a critical bottleneck in robust spatial reasoning. Recent reinforcement learning (RL) methods aim to close this gap with verifiable outcomes, yet they suffer from poor credit assignment across intermediate reasoning steps. Concurrently, structured reasoning approaches overlook the critical depth perception necessary for comprehensive 3D understanding. To address these challenges, we propose SCOUT (Structured Chain-Of-Thought Utilizing Process-Supervised RL Training). Specifically, we design a structured Chain-of-Thought (CoT) framework that explicitly models 3D environmental perception to ensure robust spatial understanding and reasoning. Furthermore, we introduce a novel RL algorithm featuring multi-objective process rewards and a tailored advantage estimation method, facilitating fine-grained credit assignment across distinct segments of the reasoning trajectory. To support our framework, we develop SCOUT-24k, a structured spatial reasoning CoT dataset synthesized through a customized pipeline. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that SCOUT-3B improves upon baseline models by 16.85% and 6.3% on general spatial benchmarks and complex spatial reasoning tasks respectively. Notably, our larger SCOUT-7B even outperforms GPT-4o by a margin of 4.28%. Moreover, despite being trained exclusively on single image, SCOUT-7B exhibits robust out-of-domain generalization to multi-image and video scenarios. These empirical results render SCOUT as a critical step towards next generation of spatially-aware VLMs.
2608.12220.paper_summary_zh: 現有的視覺-語言模型（VLMs）在穩健的空間推理方面存在一個關鍵瓶頸。最近的強化學習（RL）方法旨在以可驗證的結果縮小這一差距，然而它們在中間推理步驟中的信用分配表現不佳。與此同時，結構化推理方法忽視了全面的三維理解所需的關鍵深度感知。為了解決這些挑戰，我們提出了SCOUT（結構化思維鏈利用過程監督的RL訓練）。具體而言，我們設計了一個結構化的思維鏈（CoT）框架，明確建模三維環境感知，以確保穩健的空間理解和推理。此外，我們引入了一種新穎的RL算法，具有多目標過程獎勵和量身定制的優勢估計方法，促進了在推理軌跡的不同部分之間的細緻信用分配。為了支持我們的框架，我們開發了SCOUT-24k，這是一個通過定制管道合成的結構化空間推理CoT數據集。廣泛的評估顯示，SCOUT-3B在一般空間基準和複雜空間推理任務上分別提高了16.85%和6.3%相較於基線模型。值得注意的是，我們更大的SCOUT-7B甚至比GPT-4o高出4.28%的表現。此外，儘管僅在單幅圖像上進行訓練，SCOUT-7B在多幅圖像和視頻場景中展現出穩健的域外泛化能力。這些實證結果使SCOUT成為邁向下一代空間感知VLMs的重要一步。
